terbaru.judul: Conchordal: Emergent Harmony via Direct Cognitive Coupling in a Psychoacoustic Landscape
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces Conchordal, a bio-acoustic instrument for generative composition whose sonic agents are governed by artificial life dynamics within a psychoacoustic fitness landscape.

terbaru.judul: First Steps towards Categorical Algebraic Artificial Chemistry
terbaru.pelajaran: We construct a functor that gives a dynamics to an algebraic model of interacting components.

terbaru.judul: Identifying Influential Actions in Human-Robot Interactions
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces a method for identifying influential robot actions using transfer entropy, a statistic that measures directed information transfer between time series.

terbaru.judul: A speciation simulation that partly passes open-endedness tests
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we test for Tokyo type 1 open-ended evolution (OEE) of the Tree of Life Simulation (ToLSim), an artificial life software created by Lana Sinapayen.

terbaru.judul: LOGOS-CA: A Cellular Automaton Using Natural Language as State and Rule
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we propose LOGOS-CA (Language Oriented Grid Of Statements - Cellular Automaton) as a natural framework to achieve this and examine its capabilities.

terbaru.judul: Survival Dynamics of Neural and Programmatic Policies in Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We find a statistically significant difference in survival probability between PERL and NERL.

terbaru.judul: Digital Red Queen: Adversarial Program Evolution in Core War with LLMs
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we study Digital Red Queen (DRQ), a simple self-play algorithm that embraces these so-called "Red Queen" dynamics via continual adaptation to a changing objective.

terbaru.judul: Emergent Complexity in Nuclear Reaction Networks: A Study of Stellar Nucleosynthesis through Chemical Organization Theory
terbaru.pelajaran: We explore the emergence of complex structures within reaction networks, focusing on nuclear reaction networks relevant to stellar nucleosynthesis.

terbaru.judul: Sophia: A Persistent Agent Framework of Artificial Life
